arguments.value: The Victory Portfolios, on behalf of the Funds listed on Schedule A, and Hartford Life Insurance Co., Inc. entered into this Service Agreement dated September 28, 2004. The Trust agrees to make the Fund shares available to Hartford for purchase at net asset value, and Hartford agrees to provide administrative services for the Plans and Participants listed in its separate accounts, including recordkeeping, reporting, statements, order processing, and related administration for those accounts. The parties will use the Fund prospectus terms and, where available, NSCC systems for purchase and redemption orders and settlement. The Trust will provide pricing and dividend information and fund prospectuses and other shareholder materials; Hartford will keep required records and follow applicable securities, privacy, and anti-money-laundering laws. The Agreement continues until terminated by any party on 90 days’ written notice or sooner for an uncured material breach, and certain sections survive termination. After termination, the Trust may still have to make Fund shares available for existing contracts unless prohibited by law or regulation, and the Trust remains obligated to pay Hartford the fee in effect at termination while shares remain in the Accounts and Hartford continues providing services. Each party indemnifies the other for specified losses caused by its own errors, misconduct, or breaches. Ohio law governs the Agreement.
